name: Naive Realism
definition: One's own perspective is treated as unmediated reality and disagreement as others' defect.
boundary: Believing a well-supported fact does not itself demonstrate naive realism.

source_variants.name: Naive Realism (Naif gerçekçilik)
source_variants.definition: Seeing one's own view as neutral reality and dissenters as misinformed or biased.
source_variants.coverage_reason: No named mechanism, required state or observation model is implemented in the original Mesa sample.
